text:
eli: noticed a spike where sampled inspect traces included full user messages during a CDN retry window. duplicates got sampled multiple times.
priya: we should dedupe before sampling. Right now sampling happens post-ingest so retry storms amplify PII exposure.
sam: two pragmatic options: edge dedupe (hash+short-ttl) or mark-duplicates after ingest and suppress body persistence for dup hits. Edge dedupe preferable for storage savings.
marta: edge bloom filter with per-tenant salt could work; small window (5-15s) collapses retry storms. false positives ok but must be recorded.
eli: important: when a request is deduped we must not persist raw body anywhere. instead store placeholder `[BODY_DEDUPE_REDACTED]` and an immutable flag so it can't be rehydrated.
priya: also need headers for transparency: `X-RW-DEDUPE: hit|miss` and `X-RW-DEDUPE-MODE: edge|post-ingest`. add `X-RW-DEDUPE-BILLING: counted-once` so support can reconcile billing.
sam: embeddings endpoints are special-cased: never persist raw free-text even on first hit; store hashed prefix. document this in the telemetry policy.
marta: rollout: 3% canary for 48h. watch dedupe_rate, sample_redacted_count, billing_reconcile_delta.
opsbot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout 2024-10-08T02:00Z.
eli: action items: edge dedupe impl (marta+sam), redaction placeholder enforcement (sam), headers + billing hook (priya), console badge for dedupe hits (jess will own UI follow-up). I'll draft a brief RFC.
